instruction: Watch a Netflix original series via VLC media player, making sure to enable subtitles and HD resolution.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because Netflix uses DRM (Digital Rights Management) with Widevine encryption that VLC cannot bypass or decode. Netflix content can only be played through authorized browsers or native apps with DRM support.
metadata.infeasibility_reason: DRM protection - Netflix content cannot be played in VLC
